name: Richard Kreutzer
original_name: リヒャルト・クロイツァー
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Head Doctor
Birthplace: Germany (Munich)

The one in charge of the health of the crew. A weird guy who no matter the injury or illness will order his patient to strip.
He also likes to eat steak with a scalpel and forceps.
He was saved by the protagonist's father's in the past, so in order to return the favor he tries to give her advice.
